envelope.text: [`ChildError`] when the full name is over [`MAX_LOGGER_NAME_LEN`] or

why:
hierarchical `parent.child` loggers with level inheritance. Constraints: no allocator to concatenate the child's name, and a bounded 32-slot intern table over `&'static str` (`nros_log::MAX_LOGGERS`) with nowhere to store a runtime-built one. What a user loses: per-subsystem loggers that inherit a parent's threshold -- the same loss `cpp:Logger` records for `get_child`. Combined with `cpp:get_logger`, a C/C++ port has no way to have more than one logger per node at all.

phase-467 — this row is also what makes `c:log_severity_t`'s ancestry bound PERMANENT rather than unbuilt. rcutils resolves an unset level by walking the dotted ancestry a name spells, and `create_child` is where a dotted name would come from; the no-allocator constraint recorded here is therefore the constraint on that walk too. The two rows are one statement seen from the producer and the resolver side, and `c:log_severity_t` carries the measurement.

RFC-0102 (2026-10-05) -- DECIDED, NOT YET BUILT (phase-479). The constraint above no longer holds: `get_or_create_logger` copies runtime names into a static arena, `parent.child` fits a 48-byte stack buffer, and `rclcpp::Logger` owns its name since issue 1682. RFC-0102 adopts `get_child`/`create_child` with rcutils's nearest-ancestor level inheritance held as a parent pointer, and reverses the PERMANENT bound recorded here. This row moves to adopt-bounded when phase-479 W2 lands.

phase-479 (2026-10-05) -- LANDED. `nros_log::Logger::create_child(&'static self, child_name: impl Borrow<str>) -> Result<&'static Logger, ChildError>` -- rclrs 0.7's name and parameter shape, fallible as rclrs's is (`ChildError` = `NameTooLong` | `EmptyName` | `ArenaFull`). The child resolves an unset level through its nearest ancestor (RFC-0102 D2). Bounds: it returns `&'static Logger` rather than a value (runtime loggers live in a static arena and are never freed), names are capped at 48 bytes, and the catch-all's children are top-level names (rclrs's default logger is empty-named, so the same rule). Held by `packages/core/nros-log/tests/logger_hierarchy.rs` and `logger_child_arena_full.rs`.
